coordinate_convention.frame_indices: zero-based raw source; separately supplied one-based source and R4 timeline indices
coordinate_convention.precision: Hand-marked inspection ROIs, generally with roughly 5–20 native pixels of safety margin. NOT segmentation, alpha masks, landmarks, or anatomy reconstruction. Some boxes overlap because wrist boundaries are ambiguous. Missing/occluded anatomy is not invented.
coordinate_convention.critical_warning: Never inpaint the union rectangles blindly. They include valid foreground hair and sometimes facial pixels. Rotoscope only visible hand/forearm skin plus its defective blur halo, preserving original occlusion and all other pixels.

inspection.method: Every raw frame f24–64 viewed sequentially at reduced whole-frame size; f32–56 grid views; every f33–56 hand/forearm ROI at native source pixels; f43–46 native occlusion strip; full-action keyframes f0,16,24,28,32,56,60,64,72,80,88,96,112,120. ffprobe reads all 121 frame timestamps.
inspection.limits: No new repaired clip exists. Temporal naturalness is inferred from inspected sequential frames; final repaired take still needs actual normal-speed audiovisual review in its edit. Review does not certify hidden fingers.

combined_candidate_envelope.meaning: 21 frames / 0.875 s; transitions are optional, not automatic repainting.

repair_windows.scope_notes: Known approximate 1.5–2.25 s target refined: native inspection also found softer lead-in at 1.375–1.583 s. Worst loss of hand definition is 1.625–2.167 s inclusive. Some physical motion blur is natural; restore coherent anatomy and drawn edges without making every fast-moving frame unnaturally razor-sharp.

preferred_original_context.instruction: Keep full original five-second action available as reference/context; original picture outside the moving repair mask must remain unchanged.

compact_context_if_required.purpose: Contains initial rise, complete faulty arc, clear post-arc fingers, firm wrapping contact by f60, and the real pull into held state. Context is not authorization to regenerate these 65 frames.

temporal_context.minimum_post_context: Do not terminate the repair at a floating hand near f54–56. Include the unchanged f60–88 contact and pull when reviewing the join.
temporal_context.format_guard: Preserve original 24 fps and source duration; if a provider requires resampling, record the exact frame mapping and restore original frames outside the local composite. No unreviewed frame interpolation, freeze, loop, reverse or timing stretch.

protected_content: Her face, eye direction down-left/away, mouth, ears, neck, and foreground hair at its original per-frame location.
Her body, both striped sleeves and passive lap hands; his face, head, torso, clothing and arm ownership.
All foreground hair strands over his hand/forearm; no drawing hidden wrist/forearm through hair in f42–48.
Original shoulder/upper-arm movement and contact timing; repair must follow the existing trajectory.
Background, chairs, wall/window geometry, camera movement and all pixels outside the actual visible moving patch.

feasibility_verdict.reason: The original has one continuous arm path, contact, inward pull and held aftermath; she keeps her withdrawn gaze and passive hands. Native inspection localizes the strongest visible failure to hand rendering, with blur/occlusion around wrist and forearm. No sustained crown pat, restart or new emotional reversal was found in the examined sequence.
feasibility_verdict.remaining_choreography_issue: The high overhead arc remains if only the hand is repaired. It is a fast sweep behind her head, unlike the rejected new LTX take’s prolonged head pat. If normal-speed review still finds that arc unnatural, a hand-only patch cannot fix it: changing the path needs a larger articulated-arm/hair/background intervention and a separate review. Do not silently introduce that broader change.
feasibility_verdict.other_limits: General source camera pullback and later original drawn details remain; the plan is not a full-film approval or a claim that every source pixel is perfect.

mandatory_acceptance_gates: Whole five-second repaired action and both joins reviewed at actual playback speed, then slow/dense frames; no contact cutaway or reset.

A coherent right hand owned by him; up to five digits according to the actual perspective/occlusion, stable wrist connection, no new rings or jewelry. Do not force all five digits to be visible in a curled/occluded pose.
Preserve her away gaze, passive hands, self-supported head; his frightened attention; no mutual reassurance or clinical cure.
No new crown contact/hold, second reach or push; preserve single contact to outer upper arm, pull and held aftermath.
Foreground hair must remain original and occlude the repaired arm correctly. No face/body/camera drift outside the patch.
Use source f32 before and f54–64 after as join references; inspect all f24–88, not only clean endpoints.
Verify original source SHA, dimensions, duration, 24 fps and exact per-frame placement; do not infer anatomical quality from successful encode.

r4_context.note: Both action entries use video_t0=34, so the 36.5 s schedule split is continuous source playback, not a reset. Preserve the surrounding continuous waiting-room passage 30.167–42.083 s. Source f120 starts at 5.0 s and lies beyond the five-second action interval used by R4.
